profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MSG Sphere Entertainment
profile.geoLocationName: Morris County, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
I make tools and games for tons of platforms, including VR/AR, Windows, Mac, Mobile (iOS and Android).  I've also got a ton of experience with various CI/CD platforms, automating processes to increase productivity and efficiency in the ever-iterative software development cycle.

I also have... *triple checks notes* ... 10 years of education experience in Middle School, High School, and College settings.

Visit eeease.itch.io if you'd like to play some games and/or support me.

I'm always working on something(s).

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
Test unannounced games on XBox One, PS4, and iOS.
Use JIRA Agile software to log and track issues and gameplay bugs.
Creating and managing an automated build machine that alleviates pipeline clogs.
Participate in morning scrums; effectively communicate with other members of the development team.
Setting up XBox One and PS4 testing environments.
Prioritizing and organizing tasks with other QA members.
